articles.title: Ny CPO i Vipps: Henter produktsjef fra Spotify
articles.summary: Vipps har ansatt Maria Hansen som ny Chief Product Officer. Hansen kommer fra Spotify der hun ledet produktteamet for betalingsløsninger i Norden.

articles.title: Oda restructures tech leadership
articles.summary: Online grocery company Oda is reorganizing its technology division, creating a new VP of Engineering role as part of its Nordic expansion strategy.

articles.title: Nordic startups raise record funding in Q1 2026
articles.summary: Nordic startups have raised a record €2.3 billion in Q1 2026, with fintech and healthtech leading the charge.
